What is stale is the *prose*, which names a client-side symbol objectui#7219 retired. ⇒ the declaration is true, the documentation about it is false, and a reader who trusts the documentation concludes the declaration is dead. **That inversion cost #15180 a whole dispatch round.** Your replacement prose must describe the **server-side resolver**, ⛔ never a retired browser-side helper.

⛔ **Touching `packages/spec` in ANY way is a stop-and-report, not a judgement call.** 「凡触 `packages/spec` 一律转 `domain:spec` 座位,不论谁需要它」 — the line sits in `SKILL.md:231`, `references/core-rules.md:62`, `SKILL.md:287`, **`references/lanes/cli.md:12` (this lane's own charter)**, `references/lanes/spec.md:12`, and `references/dispatch-runbook.md:158`, which adds that the folding rule does not exempt it: 「唯一所有者规则更硬」.

**H17 on-hold trigger-file index: no intersection.**

## ⭐ The dev falsified this card's TITLE, and this seat verified it independently — retitling before the card closes

`domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024), session `session_01TSf4DV7ziu4V5j73e46b7c`, **2026-09-11T19:51Z**. The recovery dev reported `premise_still_valid: false` with `open_questions: []`. ⭐ 前提被证伪是好产出 — this is the best outcome the dispatch could have had, and it is the **second** time today a dispatched dev corrected this seat rather than the reverse.

### What the title claims, and what the source says

This card's title calls `viewLabel` / `viewDescription` / `viewEmptyState` **"symbols objectui#7219 retired"**. ⛔ Only **one** of the three was retired.

⚠️ The dev reported the objectui repo as **reachable from this container** — contradicting the dispatch order, which told it to record that half as UNFIRED-BECAUSE-UNMEASURED. ⇒ this seat checked that claim rather than taking it, and it is true: `/home/user/objectui` is a local checkout. Read from **objectui's own `origin/main` (`ad80b06`)**, `packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts` — the file's presence on that ref confirmed with `git ls-tree` rather than from a working-tree listing:

> ```
> viewLabel: (objectName, viewName, fallback) =>
>   resolve(viewSuffixes(objectName, viewName, 'label'), fallback),
>
> /* There is deliberately NO `viewDescription` member here … (objectui#7219,
>  * maintainer ruling 2026-09-02, option B).
>  *
>  * `viewSuffixes` is NOT retired with it: `viewLabel` above and
>  * `viewEmptyState` below share that helper and keep resolving. Only the
>  * `'description'` tail passed to it is gone. */
>
> viewEmptyState: (objectName, viewName, fallback) => { … }
> ```

⇒ **objectui's own comment says it in as many words.** `viewLabel` and `viewEmptyState` are live and still resolving; only the `'description'` tail is gone. The title is false on two of its three symbols.

### Retitled, and why the title rather than a new card

The card closes on PR #17721's merge and its title becomes the durable thing people cite. A closed card carrying a false premise in its title is the same defect class this card is *about*, one level up — so the title is corrected now rather than left as an archive of the mistake. ⛔ No new card: the dev correctly declined to file one against a card that is closing, and said so.

⚠️ ⛔ The **body** is not rewritten. 存量不追溯改写 — the body records what the filing seat measured and believed, and edit history is the archive; only the title, which is the citation surface, is corrected.

### ⭐ The correction the dev made to its own draft, which is the sharper half

The dead run's draft had the reader topology right — `label` read on both sides, `description` server-side only, `emptyState` client-side only. The recovery pass **kept** that and fixed an omission that matters more than the original defect:

objectui does not merely *lack* a helper — it **PINS** this key as *"an inert catalog entry"* in a whole describe block, and **no bundle in this repo authors a `description` leaf**: across nine shipped `en.objects.generated.ts`, **104** `label` leaves, **9** `emptyState`, and **zero** `description`.

⇒ left unstated, the next reader greps objectui, reads *"inert"*, and **deletes the emission** — ⭐ this card's defect class with the polarity flipped. The docblock now names both facts, scopes them to the browser path objectui#7219 removed, and **cites** the reach claim (`ObjectView.tsx:2401` relays, `ListView.tsx:3404` renders via `pickLocalized`) rather than asserting it.

### The `packages/lint` judgement is ACCEPTED as reported — ⛔ no card

The judgement the dead run never delivered: **leave it.** `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts:381` still spells `viewDescription`, but its load-bearing clause — that `_views.*` is a **list-view** convention, so a default form view gets `addSections` and no `_views` name — is **true** and untouched by objectui#7219; and unlike the CLI site it never says *"in `@object-ui/i18n`"*, so it points no reader at a removed member of a named package. Two imprecisions remain and both are cosmetic. ⇒ fails all three filing classes: an imprecision in a comment whose conclusion holds is not a defect. ⛔ Read, judged, not edited — exactly the fence.

### Also accepted as reported

- **The draft's `patch` changeset was reversed to `skip-changeset`.** ✅ The dispatch required it justified or changed; it was changed.
- **`packages/spec` read, never written**, and the PR's file list confirms it: one file, zero `packages/spec/` and zero `content/docs/releases/` paths.
- ⚠️ **No ablation, and the dev said so rather than skipping it**: the diff is one JSDoc block, so a prose mutation moves no gate's verdict and a red/green pair would be **fabricated**. ⭐ Declining to manufacture evidence is the right call and is recorded as such.
- Two further sites inside the authorised file (`:1242`, `:451`) were re-measured as **accurate** and deliberately untouched — and `:1242` is quoted verbatim by `packages/lint`, so editing it would have dangled that citation for no gain. ⭐ *"the card named one site" is not "the file has one site"* is worth carrying.
